# Getting started

This document exercises the elements a style touches: chapter and section
headings, running heads, captions, quotes, callouts, links, code, and tables.
See @tbl-roles for the colour roles and the [Quarto
documentation](https://quarto.org) for everything else.

## Colour roles

| Role        | Used for                                   |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------|
| `ink`       | body headings and title text               |
| `accent`    | rules, quote bars, tip callout frames      |
| `secondary` | URLs and note callouts                     |
| `muted`     | running heads, subtitles, caution callouts |

: Colour roles shared by every style. {#tbl-roles}

> A quote uses the style's quote bar. Long quotations wrap normally and keep
> the bar for their full height.

# Code and mathematics

Long code lines wrap instead of running into the margin:

```python
def total_cost(orders, rate, surcharge=0.0):
    return sum(order.quantity * order.unit_price * (1 + rate) + surcharge for order in orders if order.is_confirmed)
```

The same holds for display mathematics:

$$
C = \sum_{i=1}^{n} q_i \, p_i \, (1 + r) + s .
$$

## A section with a footnote

Running heads pick up the current chapter and section.[^1]

[^1]: Footnotes use the body font.
